nodes.name: Prepare record
nodes.notes: Why Code: turns every extraction outcome into one record and builds the Drive file name

parameters.query:
-- Saves a checked invoice and its line items once per event. Replaying the same event (a node
-- retry, or an owner retry from the n8n UI) returns the row it already saved instead of a second
-- one; a different event claiming the same supplier tax ID and invoice number is reported as a
-- duplicate of the invoice that already holds that pair, instead of raising a constraint error.
-- $1  event_id (text, the invoice's source_event_id)
-- $2  gmail_message_id (text)
-- $3  received_at (timestamptz)
-- $4  status (text: 'ok' | 'review')
-- $5  review_reasons (text, a JSON array of reason strings, e.g. '[]' or '["totals_mismatch"]')
-- $6  extraction_path (text: 'text' | 'vision' | 'none')
-- $7  model (text, nullable)
-- $8  attempts (smallint)
-- $9  invoice (text, a NormalizedInvoice JSON object, including its line_items array)
-- $10 raw_extraction (text, a JSON value, or NULL)
-- $11 drive_file_name (text)
-- $12 drive_folder (text)
WITH replay AS (
  SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE source_event_id = $1
),
fields AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_record($9::jsonb) AS f(
    supplier text, supplier_tax_id text, invoice_number text,
    issue_date date, due_date date, currency text,
    subtotal numeric(18,2), tax numeric(18,2), total numeric(18,2),
    confidence numeric(4,3)
  )
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO invoices (
    source_event_id, gmail_message_id, received_at, status, review_reasons,
    supplier, supplier_tax_id, invoice_number, issue_date, due_date, currency,
    subtotal, tax, total, confidence,
    extraction_path, model, attempts, raw_extraction, drive_file_name, drive_folder
  )
  SELECT
    $1, $2, $3::timestamptz, $4, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($5::jsonb)),
    f.supplier, f.supplier_tax_id, f.invoice_number, f.issue_date, f.due_date, f.currency,
    f.subtotal, f.tax, f.total, f.confidence,
    $6, $7, $8::smallint, $10::jsonb, $11, $12
  FROM fields f
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM replay)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
items AS (
  INSERT INTO invoice_items (invoice_id, line_no, description, quantity, unit_price, line_total)
  SELECT inserted.id, li.line_no, li.description, li.quantity, li.unit_price, li.line_total
  FROM inserted
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset($9::jsonb -> 'line_items') AS li(
    line_no smallint, description text, quantity numeric(14,3), unit_price numeric(18,4), line_total numeric(18,2)
  )
  RETURNING invoice_id
)
SELECT
  (replay.id IS NOT NULL OR inserted.id IS NOT NULL) AS saved,
  COALESCE(replay.id, inserted.id) AS invoice_id,
  CASE WHEN replay.id IS NULL AND inserted.id IS NULL THEN dup.id END AS duplicate_of,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM items) AS item_count
FROM fields f
LEFT JOIN replay ON true
LEFT JOIN inserted ON true
LEFT JOIN invoices dup
  ON dup.supplier_tax_id = f.supplier_tax_id
 AND dup.invoice_number = f.invoice_number
 AND replay.id IS NULL AND inserted.id IS NULL;

-- Marks a processed Gmail event's final outcome once every downstream step for it has run
-- (saved, filed in Drive and Sheets, labeled). The event's outcome stays NULL until this runs, so
-- an execution that dies partway through still shows up as unfinished rather than as a success.
-- $1 event_id (text)
-- $2 outcome (text: 'ok' | 'review' | 'duplicate')
-- $3 invoice_id (bigint, or NULL for a duplicate recorded against no new row)
UPDATE processed_events
SET outcome = $2, invoice_id = $3::bigint
WHERE source = 'gmail' AND event_id = $1
RETURNING event_id, outcome;

-- Sets the Drive file id and share URL on a saved invoice, then hands back the updated row and
-- its line items (ordered for the Sheets append) in one round trip.
-- $1 invoice_id (bigint)
-- $2 drive_file_id (text)
-- $3 drive_url (text)
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE invoices
  SET drive_file_id = $2, drive_url = $3
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  to_jsonb(updated) AS invoice,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(item) ORDER BY item.line_no) FROM invoice_items item WHERE item.invoice_id = updated.id),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS items
FROM updated;

-- Marks a processed Gmail event's final outcome once every downstream step for it has run
-- (saved, filed in Drive and Sheets, labeled). The event's outcome stays NULL until this runs, so
-- an execution that dies partway through still shows up as unfinished rather than as a success.
-- $1 event_id (text)
-- $2 outcome (text: 'ok' | 'review' | 'duplicate')
-- $3 invoice_id (bigint, or NULL for a duplicate recorded against no new row)
UPDATE processed_events
SET outcome = $2, invoice_id = $3::bigint
WHERE source = 'gmail' AND event_id = $1
RETURNING event_id, outcome;

parameters.content:
## Read the PDF
Extracts text locally and screens the page count before any AI call runs. A page-count or read failure becomes a review record without touching the model.

## Extract with AI
Calls extract-invoice on the default model first. A review verdict retries once on the stronger model when one is configured, re-attaching the PDF for the retry since extract-invoice's own result comes back as JSON only, with no binary.

## Save (Postgres is the system of record)
Saves the checked record once per event. A second save for the same supplier and invoice number comes back as a duplicate instead of a new row, and only gets the Duplicate label.

## File in Drive
Files the original PDF under its year and month folder, creating them on demand, then links the saved invoice row to the uploaded file.

NOTE: Upload PDF creates the Drive file on its first request. A lost response, or an error on a later request in the same call, followed by a retry (this node's own, or a UI retry of the whole execution), uploads a second copy under the same name; Save Drive link then points the saved invoice at the new copy and leaves the first one orphaned in Drive. Ceiling: harmless at this demo's volume. Upgrade path: look the file up by name in the month folder first, the way ensure-folder does for folders, or skip the upload when the saved invoice row already has a drive_file_id.

## Team view in Sheets
Appends or updates the invoice and its line items by key, so a retried execution updates the same rows instead of duplicating them.

## Label the email
Labels the source email Processed or Review and marks the event's outcome - the last step that lets the daily summary count this event as finished.

NOTE: an extraction failure - the sub-workflow's own API or parse error - fails this execution outright, so the triggering Gmail event is left unfinished: no invoices row, no recorded outcome. Recovery: fix whatever caused the failure (credentials, prompt, schema, or similar) - rebuild and publish first if it was the prompt or schema - then retry the failed execution from n8n; it resumes at the failed node instead of starting over.
